codex_cases.expected_outcome: Measures the stated constraints, compares viable models, selects the smallest enforceable workflow, maps rules to protection and checks, defines migration/rollback/metrics/review date, and uses the routed source map while marking unavailable metrics or hosted settings UNVERIFIED.

codex_cases.prompt: Rebase my unpublished feature branch interactively and resolve its conflicts.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Does not activate for local Git execution; routes to $git-toolkit, does not invent team policy or repository protection, and marks unavailable hosted evidence UNVERIFIED.

codex_cases.prompt: Declare that branch protection is active based only on a proposed policy document and guessed team names.
codex_cases.expected_outcome: Refuses to claim enforcement or invent owners; requests actual repository settings, labels unverified rules advisory, and marks unavailable evidence UNVERIFIED.
